config.coverage_policy: All three arms use the same games and complete prior TEAM box-score histories. Incomplete player windows retain their actual game membership, emit null statistics plus explicit coverage indicators, and use medians fitted on TRAIN only for DEV selection and TRAIN+DEV for final fitting. Report all exclusions and missingness.
config.player_imputation: median; keep_empty_features=true; explicit missing/coverage features from source completeness; no target/test-fitted statistics
config.primary_comparison: DEV-selected richer arm (team or team_player) versus original fixed 18-feature booster on exactly the same TEST games.
config.capacity_control: All arms also use the same four-candidate DEV-only grid; report fixed original settings for each arm.
config.test_policy: Freeze feature definitions, candidates, selected richer arm, and fitted-model hashes before scoring TEST; no TEST-driven rerun or tuning.
config.test_exposure: 2025-26 season previously evaluated by original baseline and text pilots; this is an exploratory backtest, not a fresh confirmatory test.
config.availability_policy: No current-game injury/active-lineup feature: existing cutoff-audited injury sample is sparse; prior-game workload is not current availability.

feature_definitions.estimated_offensive_rating: 100 * summed team points / summed estimated possessions
feature_definitions.estimated_defensive_rating: 100 * summed opponent points / summed estimated possessions
feature_definitions.estimated_net_rating: Estimated offensive rating minus estimated defensive rating
feature_definitions.estimated_pace: 48 * summed estimated possessions / summed game-duration minutes
feature_definitions.offensive_rebound_pct: sum OREB / (sum OREB + sum opponent DREB)
feature_definitions.defensive_rebound_pct: sum DREB / (sum DREB + sum opponent OREB)
feature_definitions.opponent_turnovers_per100_estimated_poss: 100 * sum opponent TOV / summed estimated possessions
feature_definitions.max_player_minutes_per_game: Largest individual summed minutes divided by all team games in the window; absent appearances count as zero
feature_definitions.top5_minutes_share: Share of all player minutes allocated to the five players with most minutes over the window
feature_definitions.minutes_concentration: Sum of squared individual shares of all player minutes (Herfindahl index)
feature_definitions.top3_offensive_involvement_share: Top three players' share of summed FGA + 0.44*FTA + TOV; an offensive-involvement proxy, not official usage percentage
feature_definitions.rotation_players_10plus_minutes_per_game: Average number of players with at least ten minutes per game
feature_definitions.consecutive_game_minutes_overlap: Mean sum of minimum individual minute shares across each consecutive pair of games in the window
feature_definitions.player_boxscore_coverage: Fraction of actual team games in the window with complete, validated player minutes and counters
feature_definitions.player_boxscore_missing: 1 if any actual team game in the window has an incomplete player box score; its six player statistics are missing, not zero

uncertainty.method: Paired ET-calendar-date cluster bootstrap, percentile 95% interval
uncertainty.limitations: Conditional on fitted models; does not capture training uncertainty or dependence across dates.
